checks.justification: The user requested two specific exchanges: (1) glass 2L induction → ceramic 2L gas, and (2) glass 2L induction → ceramic 1.5L gas. The agent processed the first correctly (item 3761330360: ceramic, 2L, gas) but for the second exchange used item 3312883418 (ceramic, 1.5L, induction) instead of the requested gas-compatible variant. The ceramic 1.5L gas variant (item 7497340597) was unavailable, and the agent proceeded with an induction-compatible item without confirming the substitution with the user.
